chair.verdict_en:
HongKong-JSS leads because its central claim is the only one in the field that was replicated. The mercury biosensor was characterised in five independent matched runs, every assessed treatment beat its matched control in both readouts, selectivity against lead, zinc and cadmium was quantified, a calibration model was fitted on four runs and tested on two withheld ones, and a self-built instrument reproduced the dose response independently. All three judges scored it within 0.072 of each other. That is a narrow project — one analyte, one readout — but what it claims, it shows.

The margin is 0.070, smaller than HongKong-JSS's own judge spread. On arithmetic alone this is a coin flip. It stops being a coin flip because the two teams fail asymmetrically. HongKong-JSS did no cloning at all: every construct was ordered as a sequence-verified plasmid, competent cells came from an outside programme, and the wiki assigns no student to wet lab. That costs one aspect out of eight. GEMS-Taiwan's failure is at the centre of the project rather than at its edge.

Where GEMS-Taiwan gains: scale and engineering depth beat every team here. Twelve-plus documented DBTL cycles where failures visibly changed the next build, four built instruments, plant rescue in three systems with mock and plasmid-free controls at n = 9–40, secreted ACC deaminase shown by three orthogonal assays and active in cell-free shell permeate at 6–8 U/mg through 72 h, and a pre-registered growth-rate prediction written down on 1 October and scored thirteen days later. The provenance ledger, the retained failures, the published disagreement between two of your own pages on payback — all three judges credited that honesty. Human Practices with dated design changes is at or above the leaders.

Where GEMS-Taiwan loses, aspect by aspect: on evidence for the headline claim (a2), the optogenetic switch is not demonstrated — ELISA is flat under green and red alike, DNPH inverts between 13 h and 16 h, red exceeded green at 8 h in the pre-cultured set — while the Results banner still says green light switches ACCD on. HongKong-JSS and Korea-HS both have headline claims their figures support; this is the single biggest gap. On attribution (a6), the Attribution page is empty on the live site, with six instructors, four student advisors and a weekly postdoc mentor undeclared; Korea-HS HAS per-member task attribution and an explicit AI-use statement, and scored a full point higher there with one judge. On replication, several load-bearing numbers are n = 1, including the secreted-activity figure that feeds the dose model and both containment platings. On integration, no forecast HAS driven a light and no light-driven culture HAS reached the reactor. On wiki craft (w3), four standard URLs 404 and the site is very long.

The skeptic changed the shape of the result without changing first place. It confirmed HongKong-JSS at the top (suggesting only a small attribution deduction) and argued GEMS-Taiwan down by roughly 0.08 for the unsupported headline. It moved Labi-Taiwan down hardest — construction outsourced to a vendor, the ML model trained on the predecessor team's data, the PI's declared role in protocol design — which explains that team's 0.5 spread, the table's largest. It failed to promote anyone from below rank 6: PLKLFC HAS the best project mean outside the top five but no attributions page at all beside mammalian cancer-cell work of unstated provenance. It did not dislodge Korea-HS, whose null coating result is reported so carefully that the judges read it as evidence of judgement.

The honest limits. The presentation video and the judging-session Q&A are not assessed here, and several of the open questions against your wiki — who did what, which page you stand behind on the light switch — are exactly the kind that Q&A resolves in a team's favour. The handbook does not publish aspect weights, so the combined figures are this panel's weighting, not iGEM's. Every score rests on reading public wikis; the Registry was unreachable for all three judges, so part documentation is scored from wiki tables throughout. This is a prediction, not a result.
chair.verdict_zh:
HongKong-JSS 居首，是因為它的核心主張是全場唯一被重複驗證的。汞生物感測器做了五次獨立配對實驗，每一個受測條件在兩種讀數上都勝過其配對對照，對鉛、鋅、鎘的選擇性有量化數據，校正模型用四次實驗擬合、兩次保留實驗測試，自建儀器又獨立重現了劑量反應。三位評審給分差距只有 0.072。這是個範圍很窄的專案——一種分析物、一種讀數——但它宣稱什麼，就拿得出什麼。

差距是 0.070，比 HongKong-JSS 自己的評審離散度還小。單看數字這是擲銅板。之所以不是，是因為兩隊的弱點性質不同。HongKong-JSS 完全沒有自己做選殖：所有構築都是訂購的定序驗證質體，勝任細胞來自外部計畫，wiki 上沒有任何學生被標示負責濕實驗。這只損失八個面向中的一個。GEMS-Taiwan 的弱點則落在專案的正中心。

GEMS-Taiwan 的得分處：規模與工程深度勝過在場所有隊伍。十二個以上有記錄的 DBTL 循環，而且失敗確實改變了下一次設計；四台自建儀器；三種系統的植物救援實驗，含空白與無質體對照，n = 9–40；分泌型 ACC deaminase 以三種互相獨立的方法證實，並在無細胞殼側濾液中維持 6–8 U/mg 達 72 小時；還有 10 月 1 日寫下、十三天後驗分的預先登記生長速率預測。來源帳本、保留下來的失敗紀錄、自己頁面之間回收年限互相矛盾仍照實刊出——三位評審都給了這份誠實加分。人文實踐有具名、有日期的設計變更，與領先者同級或更好。

逐面向來看失分處：在核心主張的證據（a2）上，光控開關沒有被證實——ELISA 在綠光與紅光下一樣平坦，DNPH 在 13 小時與 16 小時之間翻轉，預培養組 8 小時時紅光還高於綠光——而 Results 的標題欄仍寫著綠光開啟 ACCD。HongKong-JSS 與 Korea-HS 的頭條主張都有圖支撐，這是最大的一道落差。在貢獻歸屬（a6）上，Attribution 頁在線上是空的，六位指導老師、四位學長姐顧問與每週的博士後導師都未申報；Korea-HS 有逐人任務分工與明確的 AI 使用聲明，在某位評審處高出整整一分。在重複性上，多個關鍵數字是 n = 1，包括餵進劑量模型的分泌活性值與兩次圍阻平板。在整合上，沒有任何預報真的驅動過燈，也沒有任何光驅動的培養進過反應器。在 wiki 品質（w3）上，四個標準網址 404，而且篇幅過長。

反方審查改變了結果的形狀，但沒有改變第一名。它確認 HongKong-JSS 居首（僅建議小幅扣歸屬分），並主張 GEMS-Taiwan 因頭條主張缺乏支撐應下調約 0.08。它對 Labi-Taiwan 下手最重——構築外包廠商、機器學習模型用前一屆隊伍的資料訓練、PI 自述設計了實驗流程——這正解釋了該隊 0.5 的全表最大離散度。它沒能把第六名以下的任何隊伍推上來：PLKLFC 的專案均分是前五名外最高的，但完全沒有 attributions 頁，同時又有來源未明的哺乳動物癌細胞工作。它也沒能撼動 Korea-HS，該隊的塗層無顯著結果寫得極為嚴謹，評審反而把它讀成判斷力的證據。

誠實的限制。簡報影片與評審問答不在此次評估範圍內，而對貴隊 wiki 的幾項疑問——誰做了什麼、光控開關以哪一頁為準——恰恰是問答場合最可能對隊伍有利的那一類。手冊未公布各面向權重，所以綜合分數是本評審團的加權，不是 iGEM 的。所有評分都來自閱讀公開 wiki；三位評審都無法連上 Registry，因此零件文件一律以 wiki 表格計分。這是預測，不是結果。

teams.one_line_en: The field's only replicated headline result: a mercury biosensor characterised over five matched runs with paired statistics, a held-out calibration model and two iterated hardware platforms, with all construct building outsourced.
teams.one_line_zh: 全場唯一被重複驗證的核心結果：汞生物感測器經五次配對實驗、配對統計、保留集校正模型與兩代自建硬體驗證，但所有構築建造都外包。
strengths: Five independent matched runs with uninduced, empty-vector and untransformed controls; every assessed treatment beat its matched control in both readouts, with paired t-tests at the lowest tested concentration
Selectivity against lead, zinc and cadmium quantified in matched comparisons, with the largest non-target response stated as a percentage of the mercury response
Calibration model fitted on four runs and tested on two fully withheld ones, reporting error in concentration units including the predictions that failed
Nine DBTL cycles recording real conceptual errors and the redesigns they forced, plus an independent detection unit reproducing the dose response
weaknesses: No cloning was done by the team: every construct was ordered as a sequence-verified plasmid, and competent cells came from an outside programme
Attribution is role labels plus an embedded form; no student is assigned to wet lab and no figure names an experimenter
The stated goal of an equipment-free visual warning is not met — colour needs a centrifuge below about 0.5 uM
No real contaminated sample was measured end to end; soil mercury was added by the team and never measured, and entrepreneurship prose overstates what the lab pages claim
red_flags: Attributions page is only an iframe and did not render as text, so task-level ownership cannot be read from the wiki; one judge reports the external form credits a secondary PI with hardware, software and wiki writing
Registry part pages returned 403 to all three judges, so part characterisation is unverified
Internal inconsistency on sensitivity: a 6 ppb detection limit on one page against a refusal to call ~1 ppb a detection limit on another

teams.one_line_en: The most complete engineered system in the field — real secretion, plant-rescue and reactor data, four instruments, twelve DBTL cycles and a pre-registered prediction — undercut by a light switch that is not shown to switch and a blank Attribution page.
teams.one_line_zh: 全場最完整的工程系統——真實的分泌、植物救援與反應器數據，四台儀器，十二個 DBTL 循環，還有預先登記的預測——但光控開關未能證實會切換，Attribution 頁完全空白。
strengths: Secreted ACC deaminase shown by three orthogonal assays with a plasmid-free control, and active in the cell-free shell permeate at 6-8 U/mg from 18 h to 72 h
Plant rescue in agar, hydroponics and soil under salt and heat, n = 9-40, with mock and WB800-only controls and an inconvenient negative finding retained
A pre-registered growth-rate prediction with a stated interval and pass criterion, scored against a later reactor run, with secondary endpoints declared unscorable in advance
Hardware and cloning iterations driven by test results, plus a provenance ledger, 24 protocol PDFs and a 684-entry notebook with failures retained
weaknesses: The optogenetic switch, the central mechanism, is not demonstrated: ELISA flat under green and red, DNPH inverting between 13 h and 16 h, red exceeding green at 8 h in one set
The Attribution page is empty on the live site, leaving six instructors, four student advisors and a postdoc mentor undeclared
Several load-bearing numbers are n = 1, including the secreted-activity figure behind the dose model and both containment platings, with no log reduction
The system is never joined end to end — no forecast HAS driven a light, no light-driven culture HAS reached the reactor, and both field sensors have only run on a bench
red_flags: Results banner states that green light switches ACCD on while the figures beneath it do not support that, and the team's own Engineering caveat is the more accurate statement
Attribution page published but blank, verified live by all three judges
Four standard URLs (proof-of-concept, implementation, protocols, design) return 404
Two of the team's own pages disagree on deployment payback by more than an order of magnitude with no resolution

teams.one_line_en: A narrow but unusually clean chain from a cloneable tyrosinase to a bacterially made wood coating, with the best statistical honesty on the ballot and a headline coating result that does not survive its own correction.
teams.one_line_zh: 從可選殖酪胺酸酶到細菌製木材塗層，鏈條雖窄但異常乾淨，統計誠實度全場最佳，但頭條塗層結果通不過自己的校正。
strengths: Anti-His Western with two negative controls plus 4.19 mg recovered pigment against 0.03 mg for empty vector, and a spectral slope matching an authentic melanin standard carried through the whole procedure
Raw and corrected p-values reported side by side, confidence intervals preferred at n = 3, a permutation check run against the team's own favourable result, and failed calibration curves published
A real data-driven redesign: a failed single-layer screen drove the two-layer round with higher replication and a commercial benchmark
Task-level attribution for every student, instructor and external contributor, with an explicit statement that no data figure was AI-generated
weaknesses: No coating comparison survives Holm correction; the best result is adjusted p = 0.194 at n = 3 and the commercial benchmark also fails to separate from bare wood
Tyrosinase activity was never assayed, so the enzymatic claim rests on an indirect pigment index
Coatings used crude lysate of unmeasured melanin content and the empty-vector extract control was never run
Narrowest scope of the leaders — no model, hardware or software — and Engineering and Results duplicate tables at length
red_flags: Two judges report that all five Registry entries name the supervising professor as sole designer with no student credited, which sits oddly against an otherwise detailed student attribution page
Standard pages parts, model, proof-of-concept, implementation and protocols return 404
Safety page states no data about people was collected while Human Practices reports surveys and a session with children, with no consent statement anywhere

teams.one_line_en: A technically deep modular miRNA biosensor with the best Human Practices on the ballot, carrying the table's largest judge spread because its construction, its training data and much of its protocol design came from outside the student team.
teams.one_line_zh: 技術深厚的模組化 miRNA 生物感測器，人文實踐全場最佳，但評審離散度全表最大：構築、訓練資料與多數實驗流程設計都來自學生團隊以外。
strengths: Purpose-built sensor-only and trigger-only controls, a no-ligase transformation control, blank plus four non-target miRNAs for specificity, with n = 3 and stated statistics on essentially every figure
Genuine data-driven redesign twice over: nine failed toehold candidates led to an ML-guided round that worked, and a failed SWV series led to an overhaul giving a log-linear calibration
Fourteen engagements with a Before-to-After per phase, including abandoning the red/green readout, moving the user from patient to clinician and excluding workplace deployment
Real dry lab: FASTQ reprocessing, differential expression and network analysis narrowing thousands of miRNAs to five targets, with models tested prospectively
weaknesses: The complete sensing chain was never demonstrated — the fluorescent output was never replaced by the nuclease and the electrode was never driven by the biology
All targets were synthetic DNA analogues in clean buffer; no RNA, no plasma or spiked matrix, which is the risk the team's own interviewee raised
The PI designed the experimental workflow, wrote the protocols and ran most preliminary experiments, and plasmids were synthesised commercially
The portable reader and companion app are renderings and mock-ups with no bench measurement, and the wiki is very long with heavy duplication
red_flags: Attributions page renders empty, so the disclosure two judges scored from is not readable on the wiki itself; this drives the 0.5 judge spread
The ML model's training set came from the predecessor team's screening data
Malformed Registry identifier in the composite parts table does not resolve
Five standard page URLs return no content

teams.one_line_en: A disciplined four-cycle biosorption platform on an unusual cellulose-producing chassis with exemplary attribution and handover, let down by a metal-capture assay with no non-engineered control.
teams.one_line_zh: 在少見的產纖維素底盤上完成四個嚴謹循環的生物吸附平台，貢獻歸屬與交接文件堪稱典範，但金屬捕捉實驗缺少非工程化對照。
strengths: Four DBTL cycles where each test visibly changed the next build, including an induction-temperature lock and a scaffold chosen by a 2x2 screen
Expression and secretion shown against empty-vector and sterile-medium controls with mean and SD stated
A 27-part collection built for reuse with one validated scaffold carrying eight interchangeable payloads, plus checksummed design files, 21 protocols and a 91-page notebook
Attribution of exemplary completeness: 30 itemised entries, three AI tools scoped, six external contributors including the sponsor who supplied the laboratory
weaknesses: The metal-capture panel HAS no wild-type, empty-vector or cellulose-only arm, so capture cannot be attributed to the peptide rather than to native biomass
No replicate count or error bars for any metal condition, unlike the reporter figures
Nothing was tested in a real or synthetic wastewater matrix, and single-step lithium removal is modest
Passphrase gate on the landing page, team members behind a game, and long verbatim duplication between Engineering and Results
red_flags: Engineering and Results claim the mass balance rigorously proves specific immobilisation while the team's own Limits page states the opposite; the pages contradict each other
Internal contradiction about whether an inclusion-body band was observed in Cycle 1
AI tools declared for drafting substantive prose, not just translation
Wet lab hosted in a sponsor's laboratory with the instructor guiding raw data collection

teams.one_line_en: A broad four-module project with real controls, honest negative results and a model fitted to its own data, published on a wiki that still carries drafting instructions and a safety page contradicting its own results.
teams.one_line_zh: 四個模組、具備真實對照與誠實陰性結果的廣泛專案，模型以自家數據擬合，但 wiki 仍留有草稿指示，安全頁與結果頁自相矛盾。
strengths: Controlled function data across all four modules, including deactivated-enzyme, empty-vector and no-signal-peptide controls
A real DBTL record where failures drove redesign, from unclear gels to fusion constructs and milder induction
The bile-acid kill switch characterised across four promoter variants and six concentrations, with a stated threshold compared against published environmental levels
A model fitted to the team's own measurements that reports its own failure plainly, plus 14 protocols and a very long notebook
weaknesses: No replicate number or error-bar definition on the Results page although significance markers are used throughout
Keratin degradation is assayed with crude rather than purified enzyme and never quantified as mass lost
The four modules were never operated together, so the system is a design
Constructs were synthesised and assembled commercially and imaging was done by university staff
red_flags: Uncleaned drafting or template instructions left in the published Engineering text
Safety page claims the full enzyme set expresses and degrades keratin, that the circuit functions reliably, and that the enzymes are completely safe to gut mucosa — all beyond the data
Part size and accession inconsistencies between pages
Attributions page is only an embedded form and did not render as readable text

teams.one_line_en: A complete two-module project with five real DBTL cycles, a reusable graded part collection and a reader rebuilt by independent builders, held back by an empty attributions page and a one-cell capstone that was never built.
teams.one_line_zh: 完整的雙模組專案，五個真實 DBTL 循環、可重用的分級零件集，讀取器還被獨立團隊依文件重建，但歸屬頁空白、單細胞共產目標從未建成。
strengths: Controls and replicates throughout, including empty-vector and catalytic-null controls, with FTIR and confocal staining used together to confirm the polymer
A genuinely reusable parts collection: seven alleles as a graded tuning slot with a stated working window and host requirement
A purpose-built reader that was measured rather than asserted, with verified LED wavelengths and week-long repeatability, rebuilt from documentation alone by four outside students
Limits written beside the claims throughout, and a Contribution page recording two ways the team misread its own results
weaknesses: The Attributions page is empty, so the division of work between students, two PIs, three instructors and an advisor cannot be checked
The headline one-cell co-production was never run; tags were made by mixing separately produced material
Authentication performance is untested: the classifier was evaluated on synthetic data and only one imitation pair was tried
No mass spectrometry, so the pigment product is a tentatively assigned mixture, and many submitted parts are Registry stubs
red_flags: Attributions page renders empty on the live site despite named outside contributors elsewhere on the wiki
Source-organism inconsistency between the Description and Safety pages
Provenance of the indigo and indirubin used in the tag series is never stated
One Registry entry shows a biosafety screening status that iGEM reviewed and published; noted for the record

teams.one_line_en: The broadest project outside the top five — characterised promoters, kill switches and three printer generations with outstanding Human Practices — held down by no attributions page at all and an unproven targeting module.
teams.one_line_zh: 前五名以外最廣的專案——已表徵的啟動子、自殺開關與三代列印機，人文實踐出色——但完全沒有歸屬頁，標靶模組也未獲證實。
strengths: Controlled characterisation across several modules, including an enzyme variant against wild-type and native-strain controls and three new hypoxia promoters with ON/OFF ratios
Negative and failed results reported and used, including a null reporter assay traced to a mechanistic cause and a failed co-culture
Hardware engineering with quantified measures of success across three printer generations, feeding a measured filament width into the model
Seventeen Human Practices cycles each naming a stakeholder and a concrete design change, including abandoning a patented nanobody
weaknesses: The central targeting claim rests on qualitative microscope impressions in which the key constructs were similar to control
The therapeutic system was never shown to work end to end, and the prodrug route produced negative cytotoxicity values explained by hypothesis only
Statistics are asserted without replicate number, error-bar definition or stated test in most figures
All wet lab was in a laboratory strain while the proposed chassis is a probiotic; several standard pages are empty
red_flags: No Attributions page exists anywhere, while the work includes mammalian cancer cell culture and confocal imaging of unstated provenance
Six Engineering references carry an unresolved audit marker with no audit note; several do not resolve or point to different papers, which two judges verified independently
Mammalian cancer cell lines and references to BSL-2 protocols need a whitelist determination from the safety committee
Blanket AI-image disclosure in the footer that does not distinguish schematics from evidentiary figures

teams.one_line_en: A well-controlled enzyme project where the computational prediction was overturned by the team's own assay and said so, undermined by a missing attributions page and standard URLs that 404.
teams.one_line_zh: 對照嚴謹的酵素專案，計算預測被自家實驗推翻並據實說明，但缺少歸屬頁且標準網址 404。
strengths: Substrate specificity shown with substrate-swap, buffer and heat-inactivated controls at n = 3
A measurement page printing every replicate value, running ANOVA before planned tests and labelling small-n results as exploratory
A closed loop where the predicted top mutant lost to the measured top mutant and the ranking was revised with an explanation
Human Practices that repeatedly changed the science, including retargeting the intervention window and dropping a chimeric enzyme
weaknesses: No attributions page and no named owner for any experiment, with five instructors listed without tasks
Efficacy rests on a surrogate organism whose matrix is not the polymer the enzymes target, and no mineral-phase measurement was made
Activity reported from crude lysates with no specific activity or purified-enzyme kinetics
The formulation cycle HAS no test data, yet a formulation finding is asserted on the Contribution page
red_flags: All six Registry parts are credited to a designer name that appears nowhere among the listed students or mentors
Standard URLs for results, parts, description, team, experiments, protocols and notebook all return 404
Two surveys reported as headline percentages with no consent, sampling or ethics information
AI-generated imagery disclosed for illustrative figures

teams.one_line_en: A three-module project with model-guided mutant selection, HPLC-verified degradation against an empty-vector control and strong Human Practices, let down by a 404 attributions page and boilerplate standard pages.
teams.one_line_zh: 三模組專案，模型導向的突變體選擇、以空載體對照驗證的 HPLC 降解數據與紮實的人文實踐，但歸屬頁 404、多個標準頁仍是範本文字。
strengths: A closed computation-to-bench loop: docking plus simulation selected a mutant that then measurably outperformed wild type under identical conditions
Degradation quantified by HPLC against empty-vector and abiotic controls across five initial concentrations
Human Practices with named institutions at every stage and a containment module that exists because a field visit raised persistence
Complete protocols, a dated notebook with per-task student credits, and honest limitation statements
weaknesses: No attributions page and no statement of instructor, host-lab or mentor roles
The cold-inducible lysis claim rests on optical density with no lysis-gene-free control, no colony counts and no escape rate
No specificity, detection limit or recovery testing, so analytical performance is undefined
Model, Measurement, Software and Inclusivity pages are unedited template text
red_flags: Contribution page asserts an integrated sensing-and-degrading strain was built with no supporting data anywhere
Standard attributions, proof-of-concept, implementation, protocols and design URLs return 404
Caption copy-paste error on a key pathway figure, and one team bio describes a different project
Public questionnaire reported with no consent or ethics statement

teams.one_line_en: A disciplined AND-gate therapeutic with a genuine failure-driven redesign and characterised logic in the therapeutic chassis, badly let down by having no attributions anywhere.
teams.one_line_zh: 嚴謹的 AND 閘治療設計，有真實因失敗而改版的過程，並在治療底盤中完成邏輯表徵，但完全沒有任何貢獻歸屬。
strengths: A textbook redesign cycle: degradation tags abolished induction, the cause was diagnosed and a stronger promoter restored dose-stratified response
AND-gate logic demonstrated across all input combinations with growth controls and normalised fluorescence
Analytical characterisation beyond a yes/no result, with a detection limit, a dose fit and a cross-reactivity panel
Effector module taken from clone to purified protein to quantified activity against a negative control, with optima matched to the application
weaknesses: The therapeutic claim rests on purified substrate only; no biofilm and no target organism were ever tested
No attributions page and no task-level statement of who performed which experiment
Replicate number stated for one cycle only, with significance reported elsewhere without n
Notebook is embedded PDFs with almost no on-page text; several standard pages are 404
red_flags: No Attributions page exists on the wiki
Internal contradiction on the same Results page about whether circuit-triggered release in artificial lung fluid was demonstrated
A circuit-level simulation is cited as justification for a redesign while no model page or modelling data exists anywhere
Public survey including patients and caregivers reported with no consent or ethics statement

teams.one_line_en: Three AI-designed interventions on one pathway, all built and tested against controls on a surrogate the team made itself, held back by an empty Attributions page, an empty Notebook and small indirect effects.
teams.one_line_zh: 針對同一途徑的三種 AI 設計介入，全部建成並在自建替代系統上對照測試，但歸屬頁與實驗紀錄頁皆空白，效應量小且屬間接測量。
strengths: The team built and validated its own test platform first with a dose-response against an empty-vector control, which makes the three downstream assays interpretable
Controls, statistics and units stated nearly everywhere, with named tests for each route
Honest reporting of failure, including a variant that turned out to be a different substitution and a wild-type enzyme outperforming the engineered ones
Safety work beyond a checklist, with computational immunogenicity and allergen screens of all candidates and one flagged for follow-up
weaknesses: The Attributions page renders empty, so there is no record of who ran the instruments or the simulations
The Notebook page is also empty, leaving no dated experimental record
The central readout measures total free thiol rather than the target molecule, with technical replicates only and small effect sizes
No direct evidence of the proposed mechanisms — no binding measurement and no mass-spec confirmation of the enzymatic step
red_flags: Attributions page published but empty, verified live
Notebook page empty
Regulatory parts supplied by an outside company and all constructs commercially synthesised, declared in text but not reconciled on any attribution page
Part descriptions are identical boilerplate repeated across each group

teams.one_line_en: A disciplined five-strain comparison with raw replicate data on both a model substrate and real spent grain, plus a built and user-tested fermenter, let down by an unidentified product and a missing attributions page.
teams.one_line_zh: 五株菌的嚴謹比較，模型基質與真實酒糟都附原始重複數據，並有自建且經使用者測試的發酵槽，但產物未經鑑定、歸屬頁缺失。
strengths: Raw per-replicate readings, a stated calibration curve, substrate blank, no-substrate control and parental control for every activity claim
A consistent strain comparison holding across two independent systems, with every intermediate construct informative
Hardware with its own iteration, external user testing with before/after task times, a full bill of materials and an operating decision driven by its own data
Exceptional calibration of language to evidence, including an explicit list of what the team still lacks
weaknesses: The named product was never identified — the chromatography standards used cannot show the substitution that defines it
The headline conversion figure depends on an assumed substrate composition from literature and on subtracting a negative parental baseline
Constructs were never sequence-verified; integration rests on PCR patterns only
No statistical testing and no protein-level evidence of secretion
red_flags: Attributions page returns 404 and the Team page gives bios, not roles
Six standard pages are empty or 404, pushing all evidence into three very long pages
Two figure captions read as unedited instructions to an illustrator
Survey with a large minority of minors reported with no consent or ethics statement

teams.one_line_en: A rare project where biology, modelling and stakeholder work genuinely feed each other, ending in a measured fire-test result on the real substrate, with a completely empty attributions page.
teams.one_line_zh: 生物、模擬與利害關係人工作真正互相餵養的少見專案，最終在真實基材上取得實測防火結果，但歸屬頁完全空白。
strengths: Negative controls throughout the fire testing so each component's contribution is separable rather than asserted
Raw per-trial data published rather than only means, across two fire standards
A complete loop where a simulation prediction, a physical failure and a literature finding changed the protocol and improved the result
A benchmarked software tool with a data-leakage bug found, fixed and reported, plus code and weights archived with identifiers
weaknesses: The attributions page is empty and team members are divided only among schools, never among people or tasks
The secretion claim is not supported by the method used, since the extraction lyses whole cells
Protein yields rest on visual band intensity rather than densitometry, with no error bars or statistics anywhere in the lab results
The low-smoke, low-toxicity selling point was never measured, and the home page states nothing about the project
red_flags: Attributions page renders empty while advisor-performed simulation work is disclosed elsewhere
Human Practices states that instrument tests were performed and confirmed non-toxicity while the Measurement page states those results were never collected
Nine of ten library parts are labelled characterised but carry only computed scores
A safety question for the committee about work described as carried out under BSL-2 containment by a high school team

teams.one_line_en: Exceptionally well-framed and honestly documented, with grand-prize-calibre human practices and record-keeping, but the central conversion is screened and built rather than demonstrated.
teams.one_line_zh: 框架設定與文件誠實度極佳，人文實踐與紀錄保存達大獎水準，但核心轉化只做到篩選與建構，未獲實證。
strengths: 31 engagements in a consistent format, each with a traceable design change, plus a self-audit of the team's own survey wording
The problem is bounded by a real national standard and priced from named operators rather than pitched as saving the world
One clean quantitative dataset in the target chassis that then changed the next build
Unusual metrological honesty: the Measurement page separates correction from calibration, flags a contradictory record and refuses to call relative peak areas concentrations
weaknesses: No activity assay for the degradation branch; ranking rests on n = 2 relative peak areas with no abiotic control
No clone used in a functional assay HAS been sequence-confirmed
No polymer was identified — small recovered masses weighed at coarse precision with no purification procedure or biomass normalisation
No hardware was built, and Human Practices and Education together dwarf the Results page
red_flags: The team discloses that a lead plasmid design carries an internal stop codon early in the insert and that two cassette designs contain internal stop codons
An unresolved selection anomaly leaves open whether assayed cultures carried the plasmid
An instructor is declared as having independently conducted part of the experimental work
Extensive declared AI use in wiki, animation and illustration production

teams.one_line_en: A coherent waste-to-ethanol project with a genuinely new, well-documented Registry part and a model built on its own measured constants, let down by an uncontrolled final demonstration and seven missing standard pages.
teams.one_line_zh: 從廢棄物到乙醇的連貫專案，有真正新穎且文件完整的 Registry 零件，模型全部建立在自家量測常數上，但最終示範缺對照、七個標準頁缺失。
strengths: A new basic part registered with host, topology, source, sequence and five documentation records including an explicit limitations list
Enzyme activity tested against empty-vector lysate controls with replicates and standard-curve conversion rather than raw absorbance
A real loop where a combined stress test disproved the team's own reuse plan and redirected the hardware
Fully reproducible open hardware with a costed bill of materials, drawings, CAD files and a usability test whose low scores are reported honestly
weaknesses: The capstone demonstration HAS no negative control arms, so the result is not isolated to the enzyme cascade
Ethanol is quantified by a method that responds to any dissolved solute, and the derived yield is chained through an assumed literature conversion
Seven standard pages return 404, including results, parts, protocols, notebook and attributions
Kinetic constants underlying the model come from single measurements per condition, and hardware validation is entirely qualitative
red_flags: No attributions page and no description of the instructor's wet-lab role
No safety page at all for work involving hot alkali, ethanol vapour near a heat source and a recombinant host
Stakeholder quotations rendered in a single uniform register with no interview dates, recordings or translation notes
A citation's volume and page metadata do not match the record

teams.one_line_en: An ambitious two-arm project with an exemplary positive control, honest negative reporting and a cheap externally validated dryer, where the one confirmed binding number came from a commercial vendor.
teams.one_line_zh: 企圖心強的雙線專案，陽性對照堪稱典範、陰性結果誠實呈報、乾燥器低成本且經外部驗證，但唯一確認的結合數據來自商業廠商。
strengths: The positive control is the best bench work on the wiki: three conditions, two orthogonal readouts, quantification and a coherent interpretation
Unusually honest negative reporting, including that colony growth does not confirm assembly and that a reporter was uninterpretable
Human Practices genuinely drove design across five dated pivots traceable to named advisors
Hardware costed line by line, externally validated at two universities, with a build manual and a classroom trial
weaknesses: The only quantitative binding measurement was produced by a commercial screening partner, not the students
The RNA-interference arm produced no knockdown data at all, and the reporter was never sequence-verified
The attributions page is a bare link to the official form despite a vendor, two university labs and ten sponsors
No replicates or error bars for the quantified dot blot, and the experimental pull-down used a different schedule from its validated control
red_flags: Headline affinity generated by an external commercial partner rather than the team
Five standard page slugs return 404 and the notebook page is very short
Home page headline claims neutralisation, which inner pages explicitly disclaim
Shipped hardware carries a published default wireless password giving anyone in range control of a heater

teams.one_line_en: A wide six-school chain from de novo designed proteins to an operated cartridge, written with unusual honesty about its limits, but never showing that the designed protein rather than the gel does the binding.
teams.one_line_zh: 六校合作、從全新設計蛋白到實際運行匣體的完整鏈條，對自身限制書寫異常誠實，但始終未證明結合來自設計蛋白而非膠體。
strengths: A genuinely connected chain, each link evidenced: designed cargos, verified plasmids, beads and a printed cartridge that completed load, wash and elution
Three independent preparations per bead condition with every individual reading published and calibration fits stated
Three documented engineering loops where an observed failure changed the next build
Repeated discipline about what the data cannot support — elution called handling not selectivity, resistance called a plated phenotype, lithium called extrapolated
weaknesses: The only plasmid-free control exists for one bead grade while every lead result uses the other, so binding cannot be separated from the alginate
The immunoblot targets a native outer-membrane protein, so it cannot establish expression of the designed cargo
Lithium is read as bulk conductivity well above the top standard
The cartridge result is a single run with no mass balance, no cross-metal composition and no selectivity demonstrated
red_flags: Home-page summary cards state outcomes more strongly than the results pages they summarise
The immunoblot is described as contrast enhanced for display
Six standard page URLs return 404 and the notebook is a single short file
Software tools and printed-part sources live in external repositories that cannot be judged

teams.one_line_en: Four generations of metabolic engineering with real titres, controls and two tested containment circuits, undermined by a missing attributions page and a probiotic chassis that was never built.
teams.one_line_zh: 四代代謝工程，具真實效價、對照與兩套經測試的圍阻電路，但缺少歸屬頁，且作為產品核心的益生菌底盤從未建成。
strengths: Stepwise production data with a wild-type negative control and an external calibration curve, across three biological replicates
Both safety circuits characterised rather than drawn, with dose- and time-dependent reporter data and matched growth curves
Honest reporting of limits and failures, including a non-zero baseline explained rather than hidden and failed cloning rounds recorded
Human Practices tightly coupled to the bench, with a supplier conversation driving a redesign and peer comparison replacing one kill-switch design
weaknesses: No attributions anywhere and no acknowledgement of host laboratory, advisors or who operated the instruments
The probiotic chassis the whole product depends on never appears in an experiment
Kill switches are validated as growth inhibition rather than killing, with no viable counts and no circuit-free control
Several standard pages 404 and seven award pages are untouched template text
red_flags: Attributions page absent and no mentor or supervising institution named anywhere despite advanced instrumentation and simulation
Framing drift between a probiotic product claim and a laboratory-strain evidence base
One reference could not be verified and several citations are malformed or bare URLs
Public survey, park outreach and patient interviews with no consent or ethics statement

teams.one_line_en: Two allosteric biosensors built, screened and characterised with controls in buffer, artificial plasma and live cells, with outstanding human practices, let down by a missing attributions page and a reader never run with the team's own proteins.
teams.one_line_zh: 兩款變構生物感測器建成、篩選並在緩衝液、人工血漿與活細胞中對照表徵，人文實踐出色，但缺歸屬頁，讀取器也從未搭配自家蛋白實測。
strengths: Ten variants built, expressed, purified and compared with uninduced controls on every gel, with winners chosen on measured data
Characterisation well beyond a single curve: dose fits, kinetics, pH and temperature series, a six-metabolite specificity panel and live-cell imaging
A real cloning failure reported and fixed by a specific parameter change
Human Practices that changed the design, with a pathologist interview producing the dual-biomarker scheme
weaknesses: No attributions page and no who-did-what for lab, modelling or hardware work
The reader was validated with a commercial standard and water, never with the team's own sensors
The screening decision rule is validated only against invented scenarios; no real or spiked sample was measured
Conflicting goodness-of-fit values for the same fits on different pages, and no statistics on the artificial-plasma series
red_flags: Attributions standard page returns 404
Use of a human-derived immortalised cell line by a high school team needs a whitelist determination from the safety committee
Internally inconsistent fit statistics and a live-cell dose that differs between text and caption
Several Registry figure captions are mismatched, and firmware and print files sit outside iGEM servers

teams.one_line_en: Four genuine DBTL cycles ending in a transfer into a probiotic chassis under gut-like conditions, let down by a missing attributions page, placeholder Registry status and three unfilled template pages.
teams.one_line_zh: 四個真實 DBTL 循環，最終在類腸道條件下轉入益生菌底盤，但缺歸屬頁、Registry 狀態為暫定編號，三個頁面仍是未填範本。
strengths: Four linked cycles that escalate in difficulty, from component characterisation to an integrated circuit in the target chassis
Real controls in most key figures, including vector and wild-type traces, an empty-vector reporter group and a growth curve ruling out substrate toxicity
Docking-guided design that was actually tested at the bench, improving an existing Registry part into a dual-substrate transporter
A reproducible record of 24 protocols with primer tables and catalogue numbers plus a day-indexed notebook
weaknesses: No attributions page and no description of advisor contributions
The headline degradation figure is a single curve with no control and no concentration axis
Headline fold-comparisons against commercial enzymes are given with no units, normalisation basis or sample size
Several Test and Learn sections are written in future tense, and Measurement, Hardware and Software are unfilled template pages
red_flags: Contribution page states part numbers are placeholders pending submission while the Improve page states the parts are submitted
Pre-existing Registry parts are tabulated as the team's new parts
Standard parts, attributions, proof-of-concept, implementation, protocols and design pages return 404
Text and figure disagree on wild-type transporter activity

teams.one_line_en: A two-module yeast wastewater project with real comparative enzyme data and one genuine failure-driven redesign, let down by real-sample measurements that contradict the project's own premise.
teams.one_line_zh: 雙模組酵母廢水專案，具真實的酵素比較數據與一次因失敗而改版的過程，但真實樣品的測值與專案自身前提互相矛盾。
strengths: Quantitative head-to-head enzyme screen with blank and empty-yeast controls, reporting the enzyme that did not work
A genuine loop: a failed whole-cell assay was diagnosed as a transport problem, a signal peptide was added, and secreted activity was then measured
Human Practices with a published table separating adopted decisions from open questions, and named changes that removed design options
Controls in the application experiments too, including an empty-vector strain that exposed the chassis's own consumption
weaknesses: Real-sample oxygen-demand values are three orders of magnitude from the influent range the project is premised on, with no method detail or dilution factor
The engineered gain over the chassis is modest and reported without units at implausible precision
Kill-switch evidence is confounded because the wild type also failed to grow at the extreme temperatures
Stated project goals are not met or reconciled, and six standard pages return 404
red_flags: Attributions page returns 404 although an attributions form is said to exist
Headline removal percentages computed from the contradictory oxygen-demand values
Kill-switch claim goes beyond what the confounded data support
A disclosed AI-generated illustration sits among genuine field photographs

teams.one_line_en: A disciplined two-module project with same-batch controls, replicates and honest limits, let down by a missing attributions page, four template standard pages and an unbuilt final product.
teams.one_line_zh: 嚴謹的雙模組專案，具同批次對照、重複與誠實的限制說明，但缺歸屬頁、四個標準頁仍是範本，最終產品從未製作。
strengths: Every performance claim paired with a same-batch control, with the team refusing to subtract across batches
Figures meeting a real bench standard: units, replicates, individual data points and gels with a marked ladder and named lanes
A genuine two-step build where an export bottleneck was identified and then addressed, with the result correctly read as redistribution rather than extra synthesis
Human Practices that changed both the biology and the claims, including ending absolute environmental language
weaknesses: No attributions page and no task-level account of who designed, cloned, fermented or ran the analysis
The named final product was never made: no loading, no membrane characterisation, no prototype data
No analytical evidence for the quantification method — no chromatogram, standard curve or recovery result
Thin statistics on the headline improvement, and four standard pages are unedited template text
red_flags: Attributions page returns 404, as do proof-of-concept, implementation, protocols and design
A gel band annotation migrates inconsistently with the labelled ladder, and no no-template control lane is shown
The Parts page assigns medal labels to the team's own parts, which is not how iGEM medals work
Internal inconsistency on the hydrolysate result between a figure caption and every other page

teams.one_line_en: A broad two-module yeast project with a working, well-controlled drought alarm and an honestly reported failed first design, let down by a missing attributions page, placeholder pages and no soil measurement of the retention it claims.
teams.one_line_zh: 範圍寬廣的雙模組酵母專案，乾旱警示模組運作良好且對照嚴謹，第一版失敗也誠實呈報，但缺歸屬頁、有未完成頁面，且從未在土壤中量測其宣稱的保水效果。
strengths: The first design failed and is reported as a failure, with causes analysed and the design replaced
The alarm module shown against the right controls — an osmolarity gradient versus a matched salt control and an uninduced control — in liquid, on solid medium and in beads
Human Practices running both ways, with a large survey plus site visits each tied to a named design change
Hardware iterated three times against field visits, with component tests, a cost list and a user manual
weaknesses: The central promise, improved soil water retention, is never measured in soil
The plant trial HAS no wild-type-yeast control, so the effect cannot be attributed to the engineered products
Replicate counts are undefined and one set of triplicates is far too tight to be biological, undercutting its significance claim
The two modules suppress each other when combined, which is written up as consistent with the design rather than as an open problem
red_flags: No attributions page; the Members page gives divisions but no task-level account
Measurement and Inclusivity are unfilled design templates still showing filler headings and specimen text
Parts and proof-of-concept return 404; Results and Engineering carry no reference lists
Public questionnaire with a third of respondents under 18 and no consent or ethics statement

chair.robustness_en: Partly. First place survives both tests: HongKong-JSS's 0.070 lead is smaller than its own 0.072 judge spread, but the skeptic's corrections widen rather than close the gap (about -0.05 to HongKong-JSS for outsourced construction, about -0.08 to GEMS-Taiwan for the unsupported headline claim), and its three judges agree closely. Second place does not survive. GEMS-Taiwan and Korea-HS are tied at 4.169 from opposite profiles, Korea-HS's zero spread means no judge disagreement to exploit, GEMS-Taiwan's 0.122 spread sits entirely on how much credit the unproven light switch gets, and the skeptic would seat Korea-HS second on the grounds that it proves less but proves it. Labi-Taiwan at rank 4 is the least stable row in the table (0.500 spread, driven by whether a judge read the off-wiki attribution form) and the skeptic moves it down, not up. No team below rank 6 was promoted on review. So: order is robust at rank 1, unresolved between ranks 2 and 3, and robust again from rank 4 down.
chair.robustness_zh: 部分穩健。第一名通過兩項檢驗：HongKong-JSS 的 0.070 領先幅度雖小於自身 0.072 的評審離散度，但反方審查的修正是拉大而非縮小差距（HongKong-JSS 因構築外包約 -0.05，GEMS-Taiwan 因頭條主張缺乏支撐約 -0.08），且三位評審意見高度一致。第二名則不穩。GEMS-Taiwan 與 Korea-HS 同為 4.169，但分數結構完全相反；Korea-HS 離散度為零，沒有可供翻盤的評審分歧；GEMS-Taiwan 的 0.122 離散度完全取決於未獲證實的光控開關能拿多少分；反方審查主張 Korea-HS 應居第二，理由是它證明的事情較少，但確實證明了。第四名的 Labi-Taiwan 是全表最不穩的一列（離散度 0.500，取決於評審是否讀到 wiki 以外的歸屬表單），而審查是把它往下推而非往上。第六名以下沒有任何隊伍在複審後被提升。結論：第一名穩健，第二與第三名之間未定，第四名以下再度穩健。

J1.notes:
Method. Ranking is the panel convention C1 (0.7 x Project mean over a1-a8, 0.3 x Wiki mean over w1-w5), with C2/C3 for near-ties. a9 is blank throughout (p.11 Step 3; p.32 puts it in the Judging Session). Presentation is not assessed - the videos are not visible in this exercise, which is a limit of the simulation and not handbook policy (digital p.85). Because the two most heavily weighted inputs to finalist selection are incomplete, I would treat this ordering as provisional until the videos and Q&A are seen, and I expect the top five to be separable only after that.

What the side-by-side pass found. Eleven score changes across nine teams, all of them places where I had applied two different bars to the same kind of evidence, written one team at a time:

Attribution (a6) was my least consistent aspect, because I wrote these ballots over several sittings and let the strength of the surrounding project colour the attribution score. I fixed the bar to the evidence actually on the pages: 4.0-4.5 for a task-level account of who did which experiment (Korea-HS, HK League, Mammothedu, SMS-Shenzhen, Basis-China, HongKong-JSS, Mingdao, and now GEMS Taiwan); 3.0-3.5 where attribution is absent at the standard URL but task-level evidence survives elsewhere - a notebook naming operators, Registry CRediT roles, per-member role descriptions (GCGS, Keystone, PLKLFC, Squirrel Beijing, PSI Korea, ZQT, Labi); 2.5 where no task-level statement exists anywhere (HK Joint School, BIST-China, Hongwen, and now Cataverse and GreatBay-SCIE). That moved GEMS up, Squirrel Beijing and PSI Korea up, and Cataverse and GreatBay-SCIE down. Eighteen of twenty-four teams have a missing, blank or form-only attributions page; since that is near-universal in this field, I made sure it depresses a6 in proportion to what is missing rather than functioning as a flat penalty.

Registry access. parts.igem.org returned 403 to me for most teams, which is my limitation, not theirs. I had been inconsistent about it: Mingdao's Registry entry was one of the few I could read in full, and it is excellent, yet I had capped a8 at 3.5 for wiki-side 404s that I was already penalising under w3. Raised to 4.0 and the w3 deduction left where it belongs. A judge with Registry access should re-check a7/a8 for every team flagged 403 before the panel settles those scores; several could move half a point either way.

Statistics bar on a2. I had let two teams keep 4.5 without reported statistics while marking others down for the same gap. Squirrel Guangzhou drops to 4.0 on that basis. The bar I am now applying uniformly: 4.5 needs named controls, stated n, defined error bars and a test; 4.0 is controls and replicates without inferential statistics, or a controlled core with an uncontrolled headline figure; 3.5 is where the capstone claim has no negative control.

Functioning-part benchmark (C4). Used as calibration only. The teams below 3.5 on a2 - Mammothedu and Lambert - are there because the central claim rests on screening-grade data without controls, not because of the benchmark, and neither is removed from consideration by it.

Finalists. On the composite, Labi Taiwan (4.31) and GEMS Taiwan (4.28) lead, with HongKong-JSS (4.27) within 0.05 of both - well inside C3's tie-break window. Applying C3 to that trio: a2 separates them first (Labi 4.5, HongKong-JSS 4.5, GEMS 3.5), which would put HongKong-JSS ahead of GEMS. I have kept GEMS second on the composite because the a2 gap reflects one unproven module (the optogenetic switch) inside an otherwise exceptionally complete project - four built instruments, twelve DBTL cycles, plant rescue with controls - whereas HongKong-JSS outsourced all construct building. That is a judgement I hold loosely and would expect to argue in the Judging Session; if the panel prefers the mechanical application of C3, HongKong-JSS takes the second finalist place. Basis-China (4.21) and Korea-HS (4.18) are the next pair and are not far behind.

Integrity. One matter goes to rcc@igem.org: the six Engineering-page references on PLKLFC that resolve to unrelated papers, plus two that do not resolve, with the specific coordinates I checked. I give the dependent claims no evidential credit, make no accusation and propose no penalty - the RCC decides (p.25). Nothing else on this ballot warrants a referral; AI disclosures (SMS-Shenzhen, HK Joint School, Korea-HS, Keystone, PLKLFC, Mammothedu) are declarations of decorative or drafting use, and I found no evidentiary figure presented as cleaned or AI-made.

Safety questions for safety@igem.org, not for me to decide: HK Joint School (RG1 strains stated as handled under BSL-2 containment), BIST-China and PLKLFC (continuous animal cell lines - 293T, CT26, MC38 - against the High School Whitelist), and Squirrel Beijing's proposed drone release of live engineered bacteria, which has no release risk assessment on the Safety page.

Feedback to teams stays specific and kind, in my own words. The single most common and most fixable fault across this field is the missing or empty attributions page together with 404s on the standard URLs; that costs teams real marks on a6, a8 and w3 for work they have plainly done.

J2.notes:
Method: ranked on the Project mean (a1-a8) as the primary key and the Wiki mean (w1-w5) as the second key and tie-breaker, per the handbook's finalist rule (p.12 Step 8; p.31). Presentation is not assessed because the videos are not visible to me, so the official rank will differ and close calls can flip. Aspect 9 is blank throughout.

Ten scores moved, all for cross-team consistency rather than new evidence. The main systematic problem was a6. Twenty-one of twenty-four teams have no readable attribution form, and I had been scoring the same situation anywhere from 1.5 to 3.0 depending on how irritated the page made me. I settled on three bands: 2.0 for an absent or empty form with only bios or school-level roles (labi-taiwan, cataverse, hangzhoufourteenap, hk-joint-school, squirrel-guangzhou, psi-korea); 2.5 where the team page gives a real per-member role line (shsid, greatbay-scie, hongwen-school, zqt-nanjing, gcgs, bist-china); 3.0 where a notebook or task matrix credits named students with specific dated work (gems-taiwan, squirrel-beijing, plklfc, keystone, mingdao). Only sms-shenzhen, hongkong-jss and hk-league have a complete form, and only sms and hk-league pair it with student-attributed execution. This moved gems-taiwan up, psi-korea down and keystone up.

Second systematic problem was w3. I had been inconsistent about how hard to penalise missing standard pages. The bar I settled on: four or more standard pages returning 404, with otherwise sound internal navigation, caps w3 at 3.5; seven or more, or missing pages plus a naming split or heavy sprawl, lands at 3.0; every standard URL dead (hangzhoufourteenap) is 2.5. That lowered basis-china, hk-league, squirrel-beijing and bist-china, which I had let off lightly.

Third, a8. Nineteen teams could not have their Registry entries checked (parts.igem.org returned 403, CloudFront bot pages or CAPTCHAs, which I did not attempt to work around). Where the Registry was unverified AND the team's own tables show thin or pending characterisation, the aspect should sit at 3.5 regardless of how good the wiki is, since parts are judged on the Registry (p.18). I applied that to gems-taiwan and lambert-ga, which I had placed at 4.0 for wiki quality that did not earn others the same. The three teams I did reach (mingdao, hangzhoufourteenap, korea-hs, plus partial reads for greatbay-scie, keystone and psi-korea) keep scores based on what I actually saw. A judge with Registry access should re-check a7 and a8 across the whole section before the panel settles them.

Finalists on this working rank: hongkong-jss (4.19 project / 4.2 wiki) and korea-hs (4.13 / 4.3). Both carry one idea end to end with measured, controlled data and real redesign driven by test results. Immediately behind them sit sms-shenzhen and gems-taiwan, both at 4.06, separated from the leaders by a single aspect each: sms-shenzhen's metal-capture panel has no non-engineered biomass control, so its headline claim is not attributable to the engineered peptide; gems-taiwan has the strongest engineering record in the section (the only a4 of 5 I awarded, with a pre-registered growth-rate prediction scored against a later run) but its light switch is built and never shown to switch, and its attribution page is empty. If Presentation is strong for either, they are live for a finalist slot and the panel should expect movement.

Two caveats on the leaders that the panel should weigh. hongkong-jss ordered every plasmid as a sequence-verified construct and did no cloning, and a secondary PI is credited with hardware design, engineering, software and wiki writing; all of it is declared, so there is no integrity question, but the student-executed share is smaller than the project's size suggests. korea-hs lists the instructor as sole designer with Conceptualisation and Supervision roles on all five Registry entries with no student credited, which is my first Q&A question for them.

Questions I would carry into Q&A, asked as questions and not as findings: who executed gene synthesis, instrument work and simulation where no host lab is named (squirrel-guangzhou, squirrel-beijing, plklfc, bist-china); the "Devon Larkin" designer name on all six hangzhoufourteenap Registry parts, which appears nowhere on their team page; the Cycle 1 inclusion-body contradiction in sms-shenzhen; the Results-page self-contradiction in gcgs about whether circuit-triggered release was demonstrated; and the COD units in keystone that cannot be reconciled with their own stated influent load. Two routine safety confirmations for the committee rather than referrals: HEK-293T use by bist-china and mammalian cell culture by plklfc against the high school whitelist, and Komagataeibacter rhaeticus (sms-shenzhen), Zymomonas mobilis (mingdao) and Halomonas sp.
